title: Feishu channel (experimental)
description: Connect Feishu text messages to this Pi/Codex instance. Conversations also appear on the Web. Send /stop to request cancellation. Handle approvals and follow-up questions on the Web for now.
secretSaved: Encrypted secret saved; leave blank to keep
allowlistHint: Separate IDs with commas. Groups require both a permitted user and group, plus a bot mention. Each Feishu app can bind to one instance only.
saved: Configuration saved. Complete Feishu permissions, long-connection event subscription and app publication before testing messages.
failed: Could not load or save. Check the configuration, user allowlist and whether another instance already uses this app.
qrDescription: Use the existing Feishu QR flow to create or authorize a test app. Do not select an app currently used by Hermes. Review the user allowlist, then enable and save after scanning.
qrWaiting: Scan with Feishu and complete authorization. The QR code expires in about 10 minutes.
qrReady: App credentials and your Open ID have been filled in. Review, enable and save to connect; no connection has been enabled automatically.
qrMissingUser: App credentials were received, but no valid user Open ID was returned. Enter an explicit allowlist before enabling.
qrFailed: QR authorization is incomplete, expired or temporarily unavailable. Refresh to retry or configure manually.
